---
name: KestrelQueue Deployment Policy
description: Cross-session deployment guardrails for KestrelQueue releases
type: feedback
---
# KestrelQueue Deployment Policy

All releases for KestrelQueue must run database schema validation before rollout. Never execute direct schema mutations against the primary cluster during peak traffic windows. Always require two reviewers for migration scripts.

---
name: Merged Core Architecture Notes
description: L2 consolidated architecture notes covering PolarisLedger, HeliosCache, and OCV5-731
type: project
---
# Merged Architecture Ledger (L2 Consolidated)

## PolarisLedger Checkpointing
PolarisLedger persists shard checkpoints every 120 seconds using monotonic epoch tags (`epoch_v4`).

## HeliosCache Eviction
HeliosCache enforces an LRU cap of 48000 entries and flushes stale telemetry keys after 1800 seconds.

## Ticket OCV5-731 Rollout
OCV5-731 migrated webhook signature checks to constant-time HMAC verification.

---
name: CI Architecture Gate Rules
description: Mandatory pre-merge verification checklist for gateway modules
type: feedback
---
# CI Architecture Gate Rules

Before merging changes to gateway lifecycle modules, always run `check-architecture.ts --enforce` and `sessionCompactionGovernance.test.ts`. Never bypass layer boundary checks with relative cross-package imports.

---
name: Rolling Checkpoint Budget Policy
description: Updated v2 checkpoint size limit and retention standard
type: project
---
# Rolling Checkpoint Budget Policy (Current v2)

Updated policy: rolling checkpoint summaries must stay strictly under 8000 characters while reserving 1800 characters for Mid-Session Constraints and Key Anchors. The old 4000-char legacy draft limit is superseded.

---
name: Research Report Formatting
description: Preferred structure for benchmark and ablation reports
type: user
---
# Research Report Formatting

Always present benchmark comparisons with a concise summary table first, followed by p50/p95 latency deltas and exact reproducible CLI commands.

---
name: Local Observability Endpoints
description: Synthetic loopback endpoints for local metrics inspection
type: reference
---
# Local Observability Endpoints

Prometheus metrics scrape endpoint runs locally on 127.0.0.1:9464/metrics. Health probe runs on 127.0.0.1:8088/healthz.

---
name: Worktree File Boundary Rule
description: Multi-agent parallel editing hygiene and zero-overlap discipline
type: feedback
---
# Worktree File Boundary Rule

When multiple agents share one worktree, each owner edits only its assigned file list and never runs git commit, git checkout, or git reset.

---
name: Nightly Compaction SLA
description: Target latency and token reduction budget for background compaction
type: project
---
# Nightly Compaction SLA

Background compaction jobs must finish in under 1500ms p95 and achieve at least 60% byte compression on transcripts exceeding 20 turns.

description: Historical notes for the retired ObsidianMigrator v1 batch importer
type: reference
---
# ObsidianMigrator Legacy Playbook

ObsidianMigrator imported legacy YAML frontmatter vaults using batch size 250 and checkpoint token `obs-v1-final`.

---
name: ZephyrProbe Latency Study
description: Archived latency profiling notes for ZephyrProbe collector
type: project
---
# ZephyrProbe Latency Study

ZephyrProbe ring buffer overflow occurred when flush interval exceeded 900ms under burst telemetry.

---
name: CobaltSandbox Resource Quotas
description: Archived memory and CPU quota table for CobaltSandbox staging
type: reference
---
# CobaltSandbox Resource Quotas

CobaltSandbox staging containers used 4096Mi memory limit and 2000m CPU ceiling.

name: Old Rolling Checkpoint Budget Draft

# Old Rolling Checkpoint Budget Draft

Legacy draft proposed capping rolling checkpoint summaries at 4000 chars without mid-session anchors.
